de1.P1.C1.ly_do: Da chung minh: (ABG) giao (ACD) la AM (do BG cat CD tai trung diem M) nen J thuoc AM; A,J,M thang hang, DJ la giao tuyen, AM la giao tuyen - chi co A (J la trung diem AM) la sai.

de1.P1.C10.ly_do: Da chung minh: MN nam trong (SMC), (SMC) giao (SBD) la SI voi I=CM giao BD nen giao diem la MN giao SI, dap an C.

de1.P1.C5.ly_do: Da chung minh: O=AC giao BD, M=SO giao AI thuoc (SBD) nen M=AI giao (SBD), dap an D.

de1.P1.C6.ly_do: PQ la duong trung binh nen PQ song song AC, AC nam trong (ABCD), PQ khong nam trong (ABCD) nen PQ song song (ABCD), dap an C.

de1.P1.C8.ly_do: OM la duong trung binh tam giac SAC nen OM song song SC, SC nam trong (SCD), OM khong nam trong (SCD) nen OM song song (SCD), dap an B.

de1.P1.C9.ly_do: Phep chieu song song bao toan trung diem va thu tu tuong ung nen trung diem cua BC bien thanh trung diem cua B'C', dap an D.

de1.P3.C6.ghi_chu: Diem M trong mat phang (MA'C') khong duoc dinh nghia trong de bai da luu (cung khong ro mat phang (P) con dieu kien nao ngoai qua L va song song AC); khong kiem chung duoc dap an x=1. Can de goc de xac dinh M va dinh nghia day du cua (P).
